correctness.rationale: Independent recomputation from scratch confirms the exact enumeration. Fresh bytearray sieve to X=5,000,000 gives pi(X)=348513, class counts 174193 (4,1), 174319 (4,3), 174190 (6,1), 174321 (6,5) with correct exclusion of 2 (and 3 for mod 6) and exact match to archived filtered lists. Re-extracted within-class record sequences match records.json term-by-term (21/23/18/15 records, terminals [260,4874717,4874977], [272,3358151,3358423], [282,3975721,3976003], [258,2339039,2339297]). All 154 endpoints prove prime by trial division to sqrt (complete for n<=5e6); residue membership and gap divisibility by q verified; gaps strictly increasing. All 1777 interior in-class integers verify composite with minimal smallest-prime-factor (spf_td match, f<tt, f prime). CERTS alignment (seen==want) and spf run-length identity (b-a)/q-1 hold. Maximality by exhaustive scan holds: no within-class gap exceeds terminal record. Kourbatov b=0 empirical bound G<2log^2(x) holds for every record; terminal ratios 0.548/0.602/0.611/0.600 recomputed. Trend T0 values recomputed with fine-step li differ by only ~0.2-0.35 from DRAFT (e.g. 248.83 vs 248.60) due to coarse Simpson h=1000 — immaterial diagnostic difference, honestly labeled as diagnostic with no Gumbel claim. No inference error or boundary error found. Proof (trial-division certificates + exhaustive scan) correctly distinguished from heuristic trend evidence.

originality.rationale: Headline claim — the four closed within-class record-gap tables with witness pairs to 5e6 — is verbatim already published in OEIS as n-indexed record sequences with companion lower/upper witness sequences, authored by the same Kourbatov program (and Sven Simon for 1 mod 4), computed far beyond 5e6. Term-by-term match: (4,1) gaps A084162: 3,8,12,16,24,32,48,56,60,68,72,88,108,128,148,152,200,224,240,248,252,260,272,... — candidate's 21 records from 8 to 260 are an exact prefix (offset shift due to excluding prime 2; lower ends A084161: 2,5,17,73,113,... and upper ends A268963: 5,13,29,89,137,... match candidate's pairs). (4,3) gaps A268799: 4,8,12,20,24,36,40,56,60,64,68,112,120,132,144,156,168,176,184,200,240,256,272,... exact match; lowers A268800 and uppers A268801 (e.g. b-file up to 1.3e11) match. (6,1) gaps A268925: 6,12,18,30,54,60,78,84,90,96,114,162,174,192,204,252,270,282,312,... exact match; lowers A268926 / uppers A268927 (b-files to ~2e11) match. (6,5) gaps A268928: 6,12,18,30,36,42,54,60,84,126,150,162,168,246,258,318,... exact match; lowers A268929 / uppers A268930 match. OEIS entries include PARI programs computing to 1e7/1e8 and b-files/tables to 1e11, so X-closedness to 5e6 is already implied (next record upper end >X in each class: e.g. 7856713 for 1 mod 4, 9287939 for 3 mod 4, 11962963/11962651 for mod 6). Admission's decisive claim that 'no live source publishes closed G_{4,r}/G_{6,r} tables with witnesses' and that 'OEIS gives all-prime only' is factually false; it missed Kourbatov's own OEIS residue-class record sequences. New MR/BPSW transcripts, spf logs, replay scripts, and b=0 trend residuals are different certificates/diagnostics on the same known integer sequences, not a different mathematical object, boundary, or witness set. Timestamp/failed-search does not establish priority; substantive comparison shows identity. Originality therefore FAILS and is not repairable.

value.rationale: As a type, closed exact residue-class maximal-gap witness tables for the smallest multi-class moduli (q=4 Chebyshev-bias prototype, q=6 primorial case) testing the Kourbatov trend/Gumbel/open-limit program would be independently worth retrieving if new: object and invariant motivated before computation, values not mechanically implied by all-prime P(g) tables alone, future researcher could need precise pairs. Per the narrow-datum rule this is not rejected merely for being one cutoff/witness set. Hence value-type PASS. This does not rescue the attempt: the concrete 5e6 prefix is already published to much larger bounds with witnesses, so incremental retrieval value is nil — which is scored under originality (FAIL -> overall REJECT), not as an additional value FAIL.
